Error();progress={favorites:[...new Set(p.favorites.filter(x=>Object.hasOwn(D,x)))],right:p.right,total:p.total};save();score();detail(current);$('status').textContent='Progresso importado'}catch{$('status').textContent='Arquivo de progresso inválido'}e.target.value=''};$('reset').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Zerar favoritos e resultados?')){progress={favorites:[],right:0,total:0};save();score();detail(current)}};document.addEventListener('click',e=>{let b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b||b.disabled)return;let d=b.dataset;if(d.nav)go(d.nav);else if(d.play)play(d.play);else if(d.all)playChain([1,2,3,4].map(t=>d.all+t));else if(d.syll)detail(d.syll,true);else if(d.remove!==undefined){sequence.splice(Number(d.remove),1);sequenceRender()}else if(d.word!==undefined){sequence=W[Number(d.word)][1].split(' ');sequenceRender();go('builder')}else if(d.letter)$('letterNote').textContent=d.letter+' — '+letterNotes[d.letter];else if(d.answer)answer(Number(d.answer))});['search','filterI','filterF','filterT'].forEach(id=>$(id).addEventListener(id==='search'?'input':'change',renderAtlas));$('favFilter').onclick=()=>{favOnly=!favOnly;renderAtlas()};$('matrixToggle').onclick=()=>{matrix=!matrix;renderAtlas()};['buildI','buildF','buildT'].forEach(id=>$(id).onchange=build);$('buildPlay').onclick=()=>{if(built)play(built+$('buildT').value)};$('addS').onclick=()=>{if(built){sequence.push(built+$('buildT').value);sequenceRender()}};$('seqBack').onclick=()=>{sequence.pop();sequenceRender()};$('seqClear').onclick=()=>{sequence=[];sequenceRender()};$('seqPlay').onclick=()=>{let ix=W.findIndex(w=>w[1]===sequence.join(' '));if(ix>=0)play('w'+ix);else playChain(sequence)};$('seqCopy').onclick=async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fmt(sequence.join(' ')));$('status').textContent='Copiado'}catch{$('status').textContent='Cópia não disponível; selecione o texto manualmente'}};$('convertBtn').onclick=()=>{let r=$('convertIn').value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean),p=r.map(parse);$('convertOut').textContent=p.map(([s,t])=>mark(s,t)).join(' ')+' · '+p.map(([s,t])=>s+(t||'')).join(' ')+' · '+(p.every(([s])=>Object.hasOwn(D,s))?'Grafias catalogadas':'Há grafias não catalogadas')};$('wordSearch').oninput=renderWords;$('wordLang').onchange=renderWords;$('stop').onclick=stop;$('speed').oninput=()=>{$('rate').textContent=speed()+'×';if(currentAudio)currentAudio.playbackRate=speed()};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA','BUTTON'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName))return;if(e.key==='Escape')stop();if(e.key===' '&&$('train').classList.contains('active')){e.preventDefault();if(question){play(question.k);$('status').textContent='Reproduzindo questão de treino'}else newQuiz()}if(/^[1-4]$/.test(e.key)&&$('train').classList.contains('active'))answer(Number(e.key))});$('stats').innerHTML=[[keys.length,'grafias silábicas'],[Object.values(D).reduce((a,d)=>a+Object.keys(d.tones).length,0),'tons com exemplos'],[Object.keys(A).length,'áudios MP3 locais'],[W.length,'palavras / expressões']].map(([n,l])=>`<div class="stat"><b>${n.toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join('');detail('ma');build();sequenceRender();renderWords();score();
</script></body></html>
